% Pattern: number/starred-name. \newtheorem{rem*}{Remark} declares a numbered
% env whose name and counter end in a star, and LaTeX numbers it as any
% other. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
% want rem--1 remark 1
% want rem--2 remark 2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{rem*}{Remark}
\begin{document}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{rem*} Every finite space is compact. \end{rem*}
\begin{rem*} Every finite space is bounded. \end{rem*}
\end{document}
